plain: Annoyance and embarrassment over a failure.

more.text: To excite ill-humor in; to vex; to mortify.

example.quote: Suffer me to add, that, let the question be decided as it may, there can be no triumph on the one side or chagrin on the other.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, JOHN HANCOCK, February 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
